Logos in this folder

Source: Simple Icons 16.38.1 (https://simpleicons.org, https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons),
icon artwork released under CC0-1.0. Each file was cropped to the logo's bounds and recoloured
to #263e31 for this presentation.

The names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners. They are shown only to indicate
that the SIG assistant can connect to these products. Their use does not imply endorsement,
partnership or certification. Some owners publish logo usage guidelines, for example:

- MySQL: https://www.mysql.com/about/legal/logos.html
- PostgreSQL: https://www.postgresql.org/about/policies/trademarks/
- MariaDB: https://mariadb.com/about-us/logos/
- InfluxDB: https://influxdata.github.io/branding/logo/usage/
- Meta: https://www.facebook.com/brand/resources/meta/company-brand

Products without a freely licensed logo (for example Beckhoff, Omron, Phoenix Contact, WAGO,
Festo, the fieldbus organisations, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database) are shown by name.
To use an official logo, obtain it with permission from its owner, save it here as SVG and
replace the name tile in dist/index.html.
